question: Must Mahākāla be installed according to the same established ritual procedure as the preceding deities?
premises: Mahākāla is to be installed likewise.
The installation is performed in the same manner.
This procedure is remembered as traditionally established.
inference: Mahākāla should be installed following the same established ritual procedure.
plain_english: One should likewise install Mahākāla, and this procedure is remembered as the established one.
